messages:
Iris (Design): heads-up: ran into a weird overlap in the console when the compact spacing tokens are enabled. the table row actions get clipped by the persistent toast in the bottom-right. small devices are the worst.
Kai - Eng: ah ok can you repro steps? device/viewport?
Iris (Design): repro: Dashboard -> Model Versions, narrow viewport ~360px, open a row menu (kebab) then trigger a success toast from the quick action. the kebab button's dropdown appears under the toast visually and the first menu item is hard to tap. attaching screenshot and short gif.
Nate (Design Systems): thanks. quick theory: our compact mode reduces `--space-inline` and `--button-padding` and that shrinks the interactive surface. combined with `position: fixed` toast and `transform` on the table wrapper, stacking context traps the menu under the toast.
Priya (PM): accessibility concern: users on touch devices may inadvertently press the toast when they're trying to tap menu items. also this hurts keyboard users if focus ring is covered.
Kai - Eng: immediate workaround: add `pointer-events: none` to the toast while a menu is open. but that breaks if toast has action buttons (undo). maybe better: toast should avoid overlapping any open interactive elements.
Iris (Design): agree. proposed UX rules: 1) never overlap dropdowns, popovers, or focused controls; 2) toast should have a min distance from the viewport edges equal to `--touch-target/2` to avoid accidental taps; 3) compact tokens must preserve 44px min target even when visual padding is reduced.
Nate (Design Systems): implementation plan: a) add a `--touch-target-size` token default 44px and update compact aliases; b) update our popper wrapper to set a 'protected' attribute on open popovers, toasts consult that and auto-shift using small repositioning; c) add a lint rule that flags tokens that result in effective hit areas < 44px.
Priya (PM): copy nit: current toast label "Done" is ambiguous on the Versions page. propose "Version saved" or "Draft published" depending on action. let's make the toast string contextual.
Iris (Design): +1 contextual copy. also motion: the toast slide animation is long and intercepts pointer during the entire 320ms. maybe reduce enter duration to 180ms and make pointer-events toggled only after animation ends.
Kai - Eng: ok will prototype: reposition logic + reduced animation + pointer-events toggle. quick Q: do we want to keep toasts in bottom-right or move to bottom-center for small viewports? bottom-center avoids overlapping right-side flyouts but could overlap center modals.
Nate (Design Systems): bottom-center for <= 420px is reasonable. we already have motion + position tokens; add responsive rule.
Priya (PM): sounds good. please also add a short user-facing note in the changelog: "Improved toast positioning on small screens to avoid interfering with menus and improve touch interactions."
notif-bot: branch `toast-popover-guard` CI passed, preview: https://staging.redwood.ai/pr/2321 :white_check_mark:
Kai - Eng: tested on staging. dropdowns no longer under the toast, touch targets look better. left a screenshot in the PR. will follow up with unit tests for popover protection and a Percy check for toast overlap on 320px and 375px viewports.
Iris (Design): awesome. creating a follow-up to audit other places where toasts can collide (modals, inline editors). thanks everyone.
Priya (PM): thanks team, adding to release notes and QA checklist.
